title: Water Over Water

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A man can count what the river leaves. No man has counted what it takes. So the yard keeps one word for both and goes home warm on it.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the drying racks, Low Kiln

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a sixty-one-to-sixty-seven-day-old body carried everywhere; no present-tense Chicago break and no \memory{} tag are planned this chapter --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court or collector-interior scene

scenes.title: Water Over Water
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 61, Silt 2, Secondday, first light through dusk at the drying racks, the Fishstairs (short) and under the Vail roof. The Slip Brook runs higher behind the racks and the clay comes down heavier than in Ilmen; the boy, sixty-one days old and carried everywhere, hears water going over water --- the river's own note --- and his hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward it and comes down (T025, T071/T072). Sella sets the basket at the rack's edge, tells the fire it is the thaw and gives every instruction to the fire, the wool and the bucket, never to the basket; she keeps her half-pace from open slates and touches the widow's mark only before an opening (T058, T079, T085). At the Fishstairs a figure is spoken: Mira answers a question with her own answer, moves eel-bones while deciding and puts her thumb to the grey cord, showing the second twisted twice beneath it, never to Nine Pots or a door, knots uncounted (T025, T059). Berr Clay comes up short, wipes his thumb twice, holds a slate unopened, takes himself out of his own sentence and never looks into the basket (T041, T047, T077); the soft-cuffed clerk is glimpsed hand to slate before eyes, silent (T090, T080). The boy files the new sound beside the early note, the told bell, the heard bell and the kiln's four-four-and-a-gap and writes no cause (T078, T065, T061/T082). Changes: a sound the district has no word for enters his private file and the river's pressure begins the week. Advances T025, T059, T071/T072, T058, T079, T085, T083, T041, T047, T077, T090, T080, T078, T065, T061/T082, T086, T060. Withheld: no joining of trays, no experiment, no seventh hearing, no word forty, no one in three, no ending.

scenes.title: The Seventh Year Held
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 62, Silt 3, Thirdday, before light through dusk in the Clay Yard and under the Vail roof. Tarn sets the small bench knife on its sill and tells the empty yard where it is, unasked; six years counted, the seventh now nearly gone and still held back, the one entry the house cannot check (T036). Ash is worked into his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his wrist holds the light; he agrees with the early thaw and the late and keeps wanting the late one, because a late thaw puts off the paying --- but the water is up and the paying comes with it (T036, T085). His broom checks at the place where the cracked pot stood on Stone 25 and went unswept; he does not name the sound or turn his head, and the boy keeps the third interval as an object, not a hearing, with the six hearings still six and no seventh (T031, T082, T061, T076). A vessel gives its note past the yard door and his head does not turn; the two ears under one roof keep their equality and the loan that can hear stays uncalled (T076). Sella tells the fire it is the thaw and keeps Garl's coat, hollow seat and clean dark line, with the new grey beside it still unswept (T009, T013, T092). Changes: Tarn's held seventh presses against the rising water and the old interval is visited again without becoming a hearing. Advances T036, T031, T082, T061, T076, T071/T072, T009, T013, T092, T085, T058. Withheld: no count of the seventh, no naming of the note, no accident, no joining.

scenes.title: The Back Room's Cold
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 63, Silt 4, Fourthday, morning into afternoon in the Vail wheel-shed, the room off it and the drying racks. Jorra comes in from the back room with fine grey slate dust worked into his forearms past the bend of his little finger, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel, and says nothing about where he has been; the men in that room are not named (T035). The broken birth-slates stay under the rack where the yard goes around them and enters them into nothing, and the boy keeps the dusty forearms on the same tray as the clean ones without asking which slate was broken (T035, T031). Jorra speaks to the wheel before anyone --- it does not care whose hands, only if they are steady --- and tells a pot it will do; he knows the full note of a Vail pot before it leaves the wheel and would not say so before a kiln-master who would call it early and make something of it (T035, T061). His bent finger goes in ahead of his hand at the damper before Sella has finished telling him the fire is low, so the end of her sentence arrives at the pot; the yard straightens around his silence without an order (T035). He does not look toward the bed or the basket and *he's not Vail* stays sealed (T057, T058, T084). Changes: the unnameable room puts its dust into the house again and Jorra's private knowing is kept beside the boy's. Advances T035, T031, T061, T057, T058, T084, T071/T072. Withheld: no back room entered, no men named, no slate count, no hand to act, the promise of the name ungiven.

scenes.title: The Sixth Note
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 64, Silt 5, Fifthday, mid-morning in the front room of House Silt three doors down and back under the Vail roof. Sella sets the basket just inside the finger's-width-open door at the edge of the light and away from any open slate, opens no slate and turns no errand into a walk to Slate Row (T058, T084). The pewter tin above the empty bed keeps its pale fold and thumb's bright rub, unopened (T089, T074, T081). Alda comes short with soap-and-milk gone cold under river silt and lye under the soap, lays the birth-slates writing-down before she turns to the fold, presses the fold too long, touches the little tin inside her bodice without opening it, makes the two-finger sign at the flower's red edge before she knows it and covers the sign with the date she gave Dessa, then goes on with the cooper's seventh and a potter's third child after the question has stopped (T023, T007, T008, T073). The withheld sixth note is PAID here and nowhere earlier: on a narrow slate she writes in the second hand what she will not leave lying and turns it face-down into her shawl toward a floorboard in a house the boy cannot name, so the hidden record grows from five to six, unread, and buys no recognition (T023). Two private records in two materials stand in one room on separate trays and are read by nobody; the mercy-lie now curdles against a woman twenty-six mornings dead that no living person can correct (T089, T008). Changes: the hidden record gains its sixth page and the boy cannot enter either tin or ask which house holds the floorboard. Advances T023 (paid), T089, T074, T081, T007, T008, T073, T058, T084, T060, T086. Withheld: neither tin opened, no name or number from Dessa, no recognition, no one in three, no Marra.

scenes.title: Nearly Full
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 65, Silt 6, Sixthday, morning through afternoon at the drying racks in the Clay Yard and under the Vail roof. A rack-woman sets a pot down out of her shadow and under nobody's knuckle it answers nearly full, with air under the note and a want in it --- a third such answer, filed beside those of Ilmen 6 and Ilmen 23, advanced and not paid (T082). The boy files it there: nearly and full are still two sounds, he has no hand to tap the pot and ask it to speak again and no Grathic word for nearly; it is not a hearing, and the six hearings from four sources plus one from a person stay six with no seventh (T082, T061). The three intervals (Stone 13, Stone 17, Stone 25) stay objects on their own tray, kept apart from the near-full tray and the hearing tray (T082). Tarn's head goes a degree toward the note and he goes back to his broom without naming it or looking toward the basket; the boy keeps his turning beside his own hearing and does not join them (T076, T061). Sella tells the fire it is the thaw, leaves the clean dark line and the new grey beside it unswept, and keeps the carried fire at four, four and a gap under blind ash and a broken pot (T009, T013, T092, T065, T088). Changes: the near-miss repeats as another object in a private file, still useless and still not the third thing. Advances T082, T061, T076, T009, T013, T092, T065, T088, T086, T060, T071/T072. Withheld: no tapping of the pot, no seventh hearing, no naming of nearly, no explanation, no recognition.

scenes.title: The Note Under the Boards
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 66, Silt 7, Seventhday, before light through dusk at the edge of the Ilm, in the Clay Yard and under the Vail roof. The Singing Sill gives its low note earlier than it should, felt in the teeth before it is placed in the ear, and the yard calls it weather; a woman at the tubs says the water runs fast under the ice and then says weather and goes home warm on it (T085, T078). The boy sets the early note beside the told bell of the Long Night, the heard bell at the Cross and the kiln's breath under his own roof --- four low sounds in four places, kept apart for two months with no cause written across them (T078, T065, T061/T082, T071/T072). Word comes up that the weak board in the plank walk is still there and trodden by nobody and the clerk is still set at the Fishstairs for a measure nobody called; both go on their own places beside the missing step, the stopping hairlines and the new grey (T083, T090, T085, T092). He keeps the count exactly --- six hearings from four sources and one from a person, no seventh; three near-full answers advanced and not paid; the word on its own tray with the knot's shape and the weight of a thumb apart --- and the word is not spoken again (T061, T082, T024). Sella gives every instruction to the fire, the wool and the bucket, never to the basket, says the house, touches the mark only before an opening and keeps the carried fire at four, four and a gap (T058, T079, T065, T088). Changes: the district's one word swallows another plain sign while the boy's four low sounds stay four. Advances T085, T078, T065, T061/T082, T071/T072, T083, T090, T092, T024, T058, T079, T088, T086, T060. Withheld: no accident on the board, no seventh hearing, no joining, no explanation of the note, no ending.

scenes.title: Honeyed All Through
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 67, Silt 8, Eighthday, first light through dusk at the yard well, beyond the drying racks at the edge of the Ilm and under the Vail roof. The hairlines in the ice have widened and a man come back from looking says the ice is honeyed all through, not only at the edge; he says it to the boards and nobody joins it to any house (T085, T083). At the yard well the stone lip is wet, the mud is in the rope and the women speak of the skin on the water to the bucket and not to the boy; the early-thaw and always-thaw arguments still give no figure (T085, T077). He lies in the well's thin shade and keeps the number exactly while cold comes cheek, temple, wrist and the wool does less than the wind wants; he wants the bucket and the crust and can reach neither (T071/T072, T086, T060). Beyond the racks the Ilm runs under a skin so thin the dark current shows through in veins, more hairlines stop a thumb's breadth short of the edge, and the new grey in the Vail corner lies beside the old clean dark line, unswept because the house says it is the thaw (T083, T085, T092, T013). He sets the widening hairlines, the honeyed-all-through saying, the new grey, the early note, the still-set clerk and the weak board in places that do not touch and writes no cause across them (T082, T061/T082). At dusk Sella carries him up at a half-pace and sets him on his bed under the roof, not in the Debt Loft, putting the fold right without looking at his face; one crust lies in the fold with the empty place beside it, the door stands a finger's width open, and the river's low note through the gap and the fire's four-four-and-a-gap through the floor keep their separate places (T058, T086, T060, T065, T071/T072). Changes: the river's approach becomes plain in words the district still refuses to own, and the count crosses into Silt 9 unspent. Advances T085, T083, T092, T013, T082, T061/T082, T090, T071/T072, T086, T060, T058, T065, T077. Withheld: no flood yet, no accident on the board, no recognition, no name or number from Dessa, no Marra, no explanation, no ending.
